nfde01.title: Date 1 with a Fire sign: what to ask
nfde01.caption: First dates feel like interviews when every question is about plans and jobs. With a fire sign, ask what excites them right now, then really listen. Save this for date one.

nfde02.title: Date 2 with a Fire sign: reading it
nfde02.caption: Second-date nerves love counting reply times. Look at effort instead: did they plan something, and did they talk you up? Fire signs show interest out loud.

nfde03.title: Date 3 with a Fire sign: saying what you want
nfde03.caption: Hinting for weeks is exhausting for both of you. By date three, say what you're looking for and ask what they want. Either honest answer is a good one.

nfde04.title: Date 1 with an Earth sign: what to ask
nfde04.caption: Rapid-fire questions can feel like a quiz. Earth signs open up when you slow down and ask about real comforts, like their perfect slow Sunday. Let the pauses breathe.

nfde05.title: Date 2 with an Earth sign: reading it
nfde05.caption: Calm can look like bored when you're nervous. Watch the details instead: they remembered your order, they found the thing you mentioned. That's how earth signs say they care.

nfde06.title: Date 3 with an Earth sign: saying what you want
nfde06.caption: "Let's see where it goes" only works for so long. Tell them you like where this is heading and the pace you'd like, then ask for theirs. Clarity feels safe to an earth sign.

nfde07.title: Date 1 with an Air sign: what to ask
nfde07.caption: Small talk about the weather rarely gets anyone excited. Ask an air sign something playful, like what class they'd teach, and follow wherever the tangent goes.

nfde08.title: Date 2 with an Air sign: reading it
nfde08.caption: One short reply is not a verdict on the whole date. Listen for "we should go to..." instead. Air signs often flirt by planning the next time.

nfde09.title: Date 3 with an Air sign: saying what you want
nfde09.caption: You don't need a big speech to be honest. Tell them you like this, say there's no rush, and leave space for their answer. Light and clear goes a long way with air signs.

nnye01.title: Aries: what I'm keeping
nnye01.caption: Being first isn't the problem, Aries. Rushing past people is. Leave the need to win every argument, keep the courage to go first, and let it be a little softer this year.

nnye02.title: Taurus: what I'm keeping
nnye02.caption: Some things get heavy because we carry them too long. Set down the old grudges, keep the loyalty that shows up, and let something new grow in the same steady ground.

nnye03.title: Gemini: what I'm keeping
nnye03.caption: All those drafts you never sent were trying to say something. Keep your curiosity, and this year point it at the conversation you usually change the subject on.

nnye04.title: Cancer: what I'm keeping
nnye04.caption: You take care of everyone so well that you forget to count yourself. Keep the open door, stop guessing what people feel, and save some of that warmth for you.

nnye05.title: Leo: what I'm keeping
nnye05.caption: You don't need applause to be worth loving, and you don't have to look fine all the time. Keep the big warm heart, and give it real rest between the bright moments.

nnye06.title: Virgo: what I'm keeping
nnye06.caption: Noticing the little things is a gift, until it turns into fixing people or replaying every word at night. Keep the noticing. Turn some of it toward yourself.

nnye07.title: Libra: what I'm keeping
nnye07.caption: Keeping the peace shouldn't cost you yourself. This year, when someone asks what you want, try answering. Your charm stays, and your wants get a seat at the table too.

nnye08.title: Scorpio: what I'm keeping
nnye08.caption: Loyalty doesn't need to be tested to be real. Let the walls come down a little, keep the all-in devotion, and say your trust out loud instead of hiding it.

nnye09.title: Sagittarius: what I'm keeping
nnye09.caption: A joke is a great way to start a hard conversation and a hard way to finish one. Keep the honesty, drop the maybe-plans, and say the real thing first.

nnye10.title: Capricorn: what I'm keeping
nnye10.caption: Feelings don't fit neatly on a schedule, and they don't need to. Keep the steady promises you're known for, and make room for dinner, and for the heart, without a deadline.

nnye11.title: Aquarius: what I'm keeping
nnye11.caption: Going quiet when someone gets close can look like not caring, even when you care a lot. Keep your wonderful ideas, and let the right people in a little closer this year.

nnye12.title: Pisces: what I'm keeping
nnye12.caption: Loving someone's potential is not the same as loving who they are right now. Keep your soft heart, stop apologising for your feelings, and carry them a little braver.
